title: Refresh the managed Quest instruction block to quest 0.7.0
description: quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 6 with 'Quest agent instruction block differs from version 0.7.0' against the locally installed quest 0.7.0 (npm dist-tags.latest 0.7.0, checked 2026-09-15). CLAUDE.md's block declares 0.6.0. Content drift, not version-only, so --check does not tolerate it. Routine managed-block regeneration under the 2026-09-11 user ruling; hand-written lines untouched. Bumping the declared version also moves the quest that CI installs in both the Tracker integrity and lore check jobs, since both derive it from this block.

acceptanceCriteria.text: quest agents --update-instructions --target claude run at quest 0.7.0; only bytes between the managed markers change, verified by diff
quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 0 locally at 0.7.0 and on the PR run, which installs the declared version
lore check and check · manifests green on the same PR run
